proposal.reason: Main change is to network transport/plugin/proxy behavior: communicator-specific NET/CollNet backend selection and lifetime, NET/CollNet operation routing through per-comm backends, and substantive proxy progress/operation-pool handling updates. Add device-topology because topology/path construction now depends on the selected communicator backend/version (NIC discovery, PXN disable logic, and EIC-dependent path handling), which is a separate substantive behavior change.
